items.title: Integration Volumes for Non-Order Flows
items.description: Expected daily and peak volumes for integrations beyond order processing, such as returns, product master, inventory updates, and finance postings, are not specified.

items.title: Standard Integration Volumes
items.description: Assume volumes for non-order integrations are proportional to order volumes or can be handled by standard AWS managed services scaling.
items.impact_if_wrong: Underestimation of required infrastructure and potential performance issues for specific integration flows.

items.title: Clarify Non-Order Integration Volumes
items.description: What are the expected daily and peak volumes for returns, product master, inventory updates, and finance postings?
items.why_it_matters: The answer will directly impact the sizing, architecture, and cost estimation for the integration hub components handling these flows.

items.title: Specific Security Requirements
items.description: Specific security policies, data encryption at rest/in transit requirements, or access control policies beyond standard AWS security are not detailed.

items.title: Standard AWS Security Practices
items.description: Assume standard AWS security best practices and compliance with GDPR for personal data are sufficient.
items.impact_if_wrong: Non-compliance with customer-specific security policies or regulatory requirements, leading to rework or security vulnerabilities.

items.title: Detail Security Policies
items.description: Are there specific security policies, data encryption at rest/in transit requirements, or access control policies beyond standard AWS security?
items.why_it_matters: The answer will determine the specific security controls and configurations required for the AWS environment and integration components.

items.title: Ownership of Existing Integrations
items.description: The ownership and responsibility for decommissioning the 31 existing point-to-point integrations are not specified.

items.title: Customer Decommissions Existing Integrations
items.description: Assume the customer team will manage the decommissioning of the existing point-to-point integrations.
items.impact_if_wrong: Project delays if vendor is expected to decommission, or continued operation of legacy systems if no one is assigned.

items.title: Identify Decommissioning Responsibility
items.description: Who is responsible for the existing point-to-point integrations and their decommissioning?
items.why_it_matters: The answer clarifies project scope and resource allocation for managing the transition from legacy systems.

items.title: Detailed Integration Specifications
items.description: Detailed API specifications, file formats, and data contracts for all integrations are not provided.

items.title: Standard Data Formats and Future Specifications
items.description: Assume standard data formats (JSON/XML for APIs, CSV for files) and that detailed specifications will be provided during the design phase.
items.impact_if_wrong: Significant rework during implementation if data formats or integration protocols differ from assumptions.

items.title: Request Integration Specifications
items.description: Can detailed API specifications, file formats, and data contracts for all integrations be provided?
items.why_it_matters: These specifications are critical for accurate design, development, and testing of all integration points.

items.title: Data Migration Scope for Hub
items.description: Clarification on data migration scope for the new integration hub, especially for initial loads or historical data synchronization, is missing.
items.absence_note: not mentioned in the customer input

items.title: No Historical Data Migration for Hub
items.description: Assume no historical data migration is required for the integration hub itself, only ongoing data synchronization.
items.impact_if_wrong: Significant additional effort and cost if historical data needs to be migrated or synchronized for the hub or connected systems.

items.title: Clarify Data Migration Requirements
items.description: Is any historical data migration required for the initial setup of the integration hub or for any of the connected systems?
items.why_it_matters: The answer will define if additional data migration activities are in scope, impacting project timeline and effort.

items.title: Environment Types and Purpose
items.description: Specific environment types (e.g., Dev, Test, Staging, Prod) and their purpose or configuration are not detailed.
items.absence_note: not mentioned in the customer input

items.title: Standard Three Environments
items.description: Assume three environments: Development, Staging, and Production, with standard configurations for each.
items.impact_if_wrong: Mismatch in environment setup, leading to deployment issues, testing limitations, or increased infrastructure costs.

items.title: Define Environment Strategy
items.description: What are the specific environment types required (e.g., Dev, Test, Staging, Prod) and their intended use?
items.why_it_matters: The answer is crucial for defining the deployment strategy, CI/CD pipeline, and infrastructure setup.

items.title: Project Start Date and Overall Budget
items.description: The planned project start date and the overall budget allocated for this integration hub project are not specified.

items.title: Project Start and Budget Alignment
items.description: Assume the project starts within 1-2 months and the budget aligns with a standard AWS managed services build.
items.impact_if_wrong: Inaccurate project timeline, resource planning, and cost estimation, potentially leading to project cancellation or scope reduction.

items.title: Confirm Project Start and Budget
items.description: What is the planned project start date and the overall budget allocated for this integration hub project?
items.why_it_matters: This information is fundamental for creating a realistic project plan, resource allocation, and financial proposal.

items.title: In-house POS Integration Capabilities
items.description: The technical integration capabilities of the in-house POS system for receiving inventory updates are not detailed.

items.title: POS System API/File Consumption
items.description: Assume the in-house POS system can consume inventory updates via a standard API or file-based mechanism.
items.impact_if_wrong: Additional development effort or architectural changes if the POS system has limited or proprietary integration capabilities.

items.title: Clarify POS Integration Method
items.description: What are the technical integration capabilities of the in-house POS system for receiving inventory updates?
items.why_it_matters: The answer will dictate the integration pattern and technology required to deliver inventory updates to the POS system.
